end.parentNote: Vihaan practised finding the number needed to reach 100 and linking this to jumps on a number line. They used splitting into tens and ones, and corrected the mix-up of 65 + 45 after checking that it makes 110; they then identified 65 + 35 = 100. At home, practise a few examples by asking, “How many more jumps from this number to 100?” and checking the answer by addition.
